name: autonomy/mailbox
notes: Broker-backed: reads call the dashboard's /api/mailbox/* routes, which open the org's IMAP mailbox read-only host-side; sending stages a kind=email_send approval and runs host-side only after the operator approves. The mailbox password is in the org's audited vault and never enters the container: no required_env, no secret file mounts. Any IMAP/SMTP mailbox: configured on the org install Setting's broker_config.
